propositions: One-time backfill must classify closed bugs lacking close_class using only structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event infers regression, plan-review BLOCK infers plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR infers env_integration, otherwise undetermined.

Backfill must read REVIEW_RESULT events via all_review_results API and raw event-file scan (glob *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json for gate_error_v1 schema check) to detect plan-review BLOCK and gate error signals.

Backfilled records must be written as separate NDJSON artifact at .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregating them from authoritative close_class values.
Backfill script must be idempotent by ticket_id, skipping bugs already present in the artifact or with existing authoritative close_class, and must support --dry-run mode.
Revert signal must filter only substantive reverts (target_event_type is STATUS or COMMITS), not reverts of COMMENT/LINK events, to classify as regression.
All backfilled records must have is_authoritative(source) return False, and a bug already carrying state[close_class] must not be overwritten or re-emitted.
